detail.actual: Home › Applications Explore Titanium Dioxide by Application This hub organizes titanium dioxide grades by application across coatings, plastics, masterbatch, printing inks, paper and specialty materials. Use each collection as a starting point for technical evaluation. Explore Applications Request a Quote Choose an Application Coatings Plastics Masterbatch Printing Inks Paper Specialty Materials Choose by Application Grades to Review are starting points for technical evaluation, not rankings or guarantees of suitability. Open a grade page for product information, or explore an application for guidance on what to evaluate. Coatings For paint and coating formulations. Grades to Review M-350 M-510 M-896 M-996 M-2196 M-895 M-52 M-2377 Explore Coatings Plastics For plastic compounds and finished plastic applications. Grades to Review M-350 M-510 M-200 M-108 M-210 M-340 M-886 M-2377 Explore Plastics Masterbatch For evaluating titanium dioxide as a pigment input in masterbatch formulations. Grades to Review M-510 M-200 M-108 M-210 M-340 M-886 M-2377 Explore Masterbatch Printing Inks For printing-ink formulations. Grades to Review M-350 M-510 M-52 M-2377 Explore Printing Inks Paper For paper-related applications. Grades to Review M-350 M-2377 Explore Paper Specialty Materials For reviewing CR-901 in specialty-material applications. Grade to Review CR-901 How to Use This Application Hub Choose your application. Start with the category that matches what you make. Review more than one path if your work spans several applications. Compare technical information. Use current technical data to compare the grades under review against your requirements. Validate in your own system. Check the grade in your formulation and process before making a specification decision. Continue Your Procurement Review Products Already know the grade, or need a wider starting point? Use the product directory to review the portfolio and explore process information. Explore Products Documents Understand technical, quality and origin document types and how to request them. Review Documents Markets Find procurement context for your destination market. Explore Markets Share Your Application Requirements Share the intended application, destination market, required quantity and any technical or documentation requirements. Our team will review the request and identify the appropriate next step. If you have not selected a grade, choose “Not sure / Need help” on the quotation form. For an application that is still undecided, choose “Other / Not sure”. Request a Quote
